title: Arena Run
description: Survive rounds, choose 1 of 3 stacking upgrades (F5/F6/F7), discover synergies and defeat bosses.

title: Horde
description: Increasing waves of bots with changing compositions and elite waves. Resupplied between waves.

title: Gun Game
description: Two kills per weapon, finish with a Gauntlet kill. A bot Gauntlet kill demotes you.

title: Boss Rush
description: Defeat 10 bosses with rising health, armor and damage. Resupplied between bosses.

title: Wipeout Solo
description: Clear 5 squads with 3 lives. Bot respawn delays grow; win a round by eliminating the whole squad at once.

title: The Gauntlet
description: Clear 10 seeded stages: weapon trials, survival fights, duel-like encounters and bosses.

title: Last Stand
description: One life. The threat level rises every 5 kills and every minute. Score is kills and survival time.

title: Bounty Hunt
description: Eliminate 8 marked targets (they leave a Haste smoke trail) while the rest of the squad interferes.

title: Rocket Tag
description: Rocket-only target chase: eliminate 10 marked targets.

title: Movement Hunter
description: Survive 90 seconds against armed bots using movement, routes and evasion.

title: Predator
description: Start fragile; kills heal you, but go 8 seconds without one and you starve. Reach 25 kills.

title: Accuracy Trial
description: 20 Lightning Gun kills. Results show hits, damage per kill and time-to-kill.

title: Speedrun Combat
description: Clear 15 kills as fast as possible, with splits against your best time.

title: Random Loadout
description: Reach 20 kills while your curated weapon loadout rerolls every 4 kills and after each death.

title: Duel 2v1
description: Exactly two opponents, Director-tuned pressure throughout. One life — see how long you last.
